title: Warehouse or lakehouse: where T-SQL writes
objectives: Tell which Fabric item a T-SQL statement can write to
Create a table with the types you chose, then load it
Avoid SELECT ... INTO tables whose types are guessed

exercises.prompt: Create daily_revenue with day DATE and revenue DECIMAL(12, 2), both NOT NULL, and load one row per day from sales.
hints: The starter lets the query decide: the column is called sold_on and revenue comes out as a DOUBLE.
Write CREATE TABLE daily_revenue (day DATE NOT NULL, revenue DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL) first.
Then INSERT INTO daily_revenue (day, revenue) SELECT sold_on, sum(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY sold_on.
